title: Weighted count on the bowtie (two triangles sharing a vertex): AND gates plus wide OR gates plus twice the narrow OR gates number at least 10
statement: ∀ (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (A B D : Finset ℕ), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 C → (∀ x : Fin 5 → Bool, (C.eval (List.ofFn x) = true ↔ ∃ u v : Fin 5, (u.val, v.val) ∈ ([(0, 1), (0, 2), (1, 2), (0, 3), (0, 4), (3, 4)] : List (ℕ × ℕ)) ∧ x u = true ∧ x v = true)) → (∀ (j : ℕ) (g : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate), C.gates[j]? = some g → g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and → j ∈ A) → (∀ (j : ℕ) (g : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate), C.gates[j]? = some g → g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or → (∃ u v : Fin 5, u ≠ v ∧ (C.wires (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin 5 => decide (i = u)))).getD (5 + j) false = true ∧ (C.wires (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin 5 => decide (i = v)))).getD (5 + j) false = true) → j ∈ B) → (∀ (j : ℕ) (g : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate), C.gates[j]? = some g → g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or → ¬ (∃ u v : Fin 5, u ≠ v ∧ (C.wires (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin 5 => decide (i = u)))).getD (5 + j) false = true ∧ (C.wires (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin 5 => decide (i = v)))).getD (5 + j) false = true) → j ∈ D) → 10 ≤ A.card + B.card + 2 * D.card
unlocks: An exact small value of a count of gates by type: data for the library
context: SKETCH: no route from checked values; an exhaustive certificate over small circuits of AND and OR gates, decided by the kernel. Finite. An OR gate is wide when it is true at two single-vertex inputs, narrow otherwise. In-house check: an exact search over reduced circuits finished and found none below 10; the count is attained by an explicit gate list (computed, not checked). Uses only the definitions root.
